name: D8b prospective optimization-stability confirmation
purpose: test whether smooth learning-rate decay makes D8 exact same-example recovery stable across fixed seeds
scope: TRAIN-only same-example confirmation; cannot authorize DEV, TEST, deployment, or visual transfer

data.selection: identical eight groups used by D6-D8 audits

optimization.batching: deterministic full batch of all eight groups and six levels
optimization.checkpoint_selection: fixed final step for every seed; no best-seed or intermediate selection

replication_decision: all three fixed final checkpoints must pass every per-seed gate

interpretation.all_pass: same-example formulation is stable; authorize one episode-held-out TRAIN evaluation
interpretation.any_fail: optimization/output scaling remains unstable; do not open held-out TRAIN
